name: Crooked Creek (AGFC water trail) — Pyatt #2 Boat Ramp to Lower Crooked Creek Boat Ramp
blurb: Crooked Creek, a rain-fed Ozark smallmouth stream between AGFC accesses on the Crooked Creek Water Trail.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Pyatt #2 Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Take-out Snow Crooked Creek Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. AGFC Crooked Creek Water Trail: "The water level in the creek depends entirely on rainfall." Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
